05 / DOCUMENT

Model cards

Fixed training recipe · seed 42
LINEAR BASELINE

Logistic regression

StandardScaler + balanced logistic regression. C = 1, maximum 3,000 iterations.

Strength
Compact model, fast scoring, inspectable coefficients.
Trade-off
Linear boundary; correlated features complicate coefficient interpretation.
Imbalance handling
Training-only balanced class weights.
TREE ENSEMBLE

Random forest

300 trees, minimum leaf size 2, balanced class weights. No scaling needed.

Strength
Captures nonlinear patterns and interactions.
Trade-off
Larger model with less transparent individual decisions.
Imbalance handling
Training-only balanced class weights.
Evaluation design & responsible use

A clean separation

341 training cases → 114 validation cases → 114 held-out test cases. Splits are stratified; the scaler learns only from training. Thresholds use validation cost minimization over 0.05–0.95 in 0.01 steps. Model selection uses validation cost, then F1.

What this does not establish

A small historical dataset and a single split do not establish clinical utility or statistical superiority. Scores are not calibrated risk estimates. No external validation or demographic fairness evaluation is available. For education only, not diagnosis or deployment.
